sights.address: 14 N Moore St, New York, NY 10013
sights.w: This active FDNY firehouse is the exterior of the Ghostbusters' HQ in the 1984 film and its sequels.
The comic-book address of Doctor Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum; the corner tenement is a real Village pilgrimage spot.

sights.address: 55 Central Park West, New York, NY 10023
sights.w: Dana Barrett's apartment tower and the rooftop temple of Gozer in the original Ghostbusters; exteriors shot here.
The West Village corner building used for the exterior of Monica's apartment on Friends for all ten seasons.
The brownstone stoop that stood in for Carrie's apartment on Sex and the City from season three on.
Kevin McCallister's grand hotel in Home Alone 2: Lost in New York; still an operating landmark hotel.
The real skyscraper the filmmakers digitally topped to create Stark/Avengers Tower in the MCU films.

sights.n: Men in Black HQ (Battery Vent Building)
sights.w: The Brooklyn-Battery Tunnel ventilation building used as the MiB Headquarters exterior in all three films.
The Art Deco tower and its giant lobby globe served as the Daily Planet in the 1978 Superman film.

sights.address: 10 St. Luke's Place, New York, NY 10014
sights.w: The Village brownstone used for exterior shots of the Huxtable home on The Cosby Show.
The Flemish Revival Harlem townhouse Wes Anderson rented as the Tenenbaum family home.

sights.address: 1 Wall Street Court, New York, NY 10005
sights.w: The flatiron-shaped Beaver Building is the exterior of the assassins' Continental Hotel in the John Wick films.
Nintendo's two-story US flagship store with playable games, exclusive merch, and a museum of consoles.
The legendary toy store, home to a walk-on floor piano recalling Tom Hanks's dance in the movie Big.
LEGO's Rockefeller Center flagship, packed with NYC-themed brick builds and a Statue of Liberty model.
The jeweler Holly Golightly gazes into in Breakfast at Tiffany's; the store displays her film dress.

sights.address: W 167th St Step Street at Shakespeare Ave, Bronx, NY 10452
sights.w: The Highbridge step-street where Arthur Fleck dances in Joker (2019); now a Bronx tourist draw.
The Brooklyn Heights brownstone that played the Castorini family home in the 1987 film Moonstruck.

sights.address: Stuyvesant Ave btwn Lexington & Quincy, Brooklyn, NY 11221
sights.w: The Bed-Stuy block where Spike Lee shot Do the Right Thing, renamed in the film's honor in 2015.
The Emerson Hill Tudor used for Connie's wedding and the Corleone compound opening of The Godfather.

food.w: The whimsical Upper East Side cafe where the John Cusack rom-com Serendipity is set and filmed.
The Midtown Irish bar whose back-wall mural inspired MacLaren's Pub on How I Met Your Mother.
The gleaming Art Deco Chelsea diner featured in Woody Allen's Manhattan and Men in Black II.
